Du magst [b]Twinstickshooter[/b] und spielst gerne auf der Couch mit oder gegen deine Freunde? Dann bist du hier richtig!!! [h1] Tank Game! [/h1]

[h1] INTRO [/h1]
Ballistic Tanks is an arcade twin-stick shooter tank game with several local co-op modes and a fantastic arcade mode. It reminds me of the tanks minigame in Wii Play but covered in neon and a lot more challenge. 

[h1] MECHANICS [/h1]
Your tank moves pretty slowly but can turn on a dime (which is unrealistic, but I prefer this). The bullets you and most other tanks shoot in this game are fast and deadly, killing the other tank in one shot. Dodging these shots is near impossible, so you’re better off deflecting shots with your own bullets. There are numerous powerups in Ballistic Tanks ranging from a simple shield to the ability to shoot a shotgun-esque spread to explosive bullets. 

[h1] VERSUS [/h1]
There are a ton of different modes to play in Ballistic Tanks. In the versus section, there are things such as deathmatch, powershift (randomized modifiers), and juggernaut, which plays like king of the hill. Each modes can be modified towards your preference. You can disable powerups or allow increased spawns, change bullet speed or range, tweak AI difficulty or victories required. You can play with up to 3 local buddies or with bots. 

[h1] ARCADE [/h1]
Arcade mode plays like you would expect. 25 rounds ending with a boss fight, each round played on 1 of several different premade maps, and just get as much score as possible. Run variety is good enough with a surprising amount of enemy types ranging from your usual standard tanks to airplanes that drop bombs to flak cannon shooters. A lot of the enemy types in arcade shoot abnormal bullets that can actually be dodged, so this mode plays more like a standard bullet hell arcade game. Each round you survive also gives you a randomized upgrade that can be bullet range, extra lives, etc. It’s pretty tough even on the normal difficulty. You can partner up with a friend in local co-op in this mode as well, and in single-player this is where your time would best be spent. 

[h1] THE UNFORTUNATES [/h1]
Ballistic Tanks’ biggest issue is that it lacks online multi-player. Now, this is usually something I would consider a non issue, but this game was BUILT to be a party game, so to see it lack online is sad. It works very well as a local party game, so consider it a worthy purchase if you have some real life buddies. The single-player content via arcade mode is also just fine, but still, Ballistic Tanks was a game that feels like it was made with multi-player front and center.

[h1] THE BEST [/h1]
Ballistic Tanks is the best arcadey tank game I own. It’s simple, light hearted fun and has *just* enough to do to warrant the cheap price tag. I recommend full price unless you can’t stand the idea of no online multi-player.
